scope: three boss hazard body clips; VFX remain separately pending

derivation.method: Generated articulated open palm, cropped by recorded polygon and attached to the approved three-piece front-arm rig. Original helmet,body,small rear arm,plated legs and fixed soles are preserved. Supported torso loading and closed-gauntlet stoop return use the approved support rig. Windup opens forward below shoulder height; execution presses down and releases to the knee; recovery returns to exact neutral. Low-alpha resampling cleanup is explicit in the rig source.
derivation.reason: The full generated key changes the approved boot placement and stance width; reuse only its new hand paint to preserve planted-foot continuity.
